# RG_Flow_Transformer

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A transformer architecture that integrates renormalization group flow to encode scale-free dynamics in scarce EEG data. Provides a method for capturing multi-scale temporal dynamics in low-data neural recordings, relevant for neuromorphic and topology-aware processing.
